thread:
maria: Compliance asked for a "one-click" export for "who changed routing policies". They want opt-in actor resolution and admin-only mapping. Can we spec this?
jeff: We need job-level quotas. Large exports can spike GPU/IO and hurt latency.
sam: Agree. Add an export_quota separate from stream_quota. Also circuit-breaker for jobs > 1h.
nana: ana: Security: do not include emails by default. Default = hashed actor id + actor_hint (team/role). Mapping file allowed only for admins and must be KMS-protected.
security-team: +1. Presigned S3 links with short TTL, mapping as separate artifact encrypted with KMS. Log access to mapping.
maria: Console UX: export modal with radio for actor resolution: "none / hashed / mapped (admin)". If mapped selected require admin 2FA and extra approval.
jeff: API sketch: POST /v1/audit/exports { range, filters, actor_resolution: "none|hashed|mapped" } -> 202 { job_id, estimated_count }. Add header X-Export-Mode on stream.
sam: Backend: stream NDJSON; each line: ts,event,policy_version,actor,actor_hint,diff,auth_proof_ref. For hashed set actor="hash:<hex>". For mapped use actor="alias:<id>" and produce separate mapping file.
audit-bot: Export job queued job=ex_20260320_9001 estimated time 90s for 25k events.
nana: ana: Telemetry: show estimated token cost and runtime in modal. Warn if >10m and require admin override if >30m.
jeff: Also throttle number of concurrent export jobs per-tenant to protect circuits.
maria: Edge: canary rollouts produce many micro-changes. Include policy_version and rollout_anchor so exports can be stitched into a single timeline.
security-team: Add requirement: export must include signed authorization proof reference (auth_proof_ref) for each change.
sam: Quick NDJSON example lines: 
{"ts":"2026-03-20T15:00:00Z","event":"route.change","policy_version":"pv_42","actor":"hash:3f1b9c","actor_hint":"team=payments;role=admin","diff":"+route A->B","auth_proof_ref":"sig_abc123"}
{"ts":"2026-03-20T15:01:00Z","event":"route.canary","policy_version":"pv_43","actor":"alias:alice","actor_hint":"role=dev","diff":"canary 10%","auth_proof_ref":"sig_def456"}

maria: I'll file a compliance ticket for mapping retention and draft the API doc. Let's review Wed 11am.
